description: A 2-deep pool with a 1-high stretch under waterlogged bottom slabs (x 4 to 7) and lily pads on the surface (x 10 to 12): sink, sprint-swim along the bottom under the slabs, stop there (the pose stays swimming), swim on slowly, sprint again under the lily pads, stop and stand, swim up into them, then forward and out.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
